svg.title: StreamDecisionBench — single-model leaderboard
svg.desc: 17 single-model settings, 8 cloud APIs and 9 self-hosted open-weight settings. Normalized log-AUC over update intervals of 0.5–8 seconds; one recorded pass per setting.
svg.text: Normalized log-AUC over 0.5–8 s · Higher is better
